prompt: What did the PCAOB's latest inspection publication say, and what does it mean for our ITGC testing?
assertions: Identifies the October 22, 2026 Spotlight: Staff Update on 2025 Inspections of Public Company Audits
States the aggregate Part I.A deficiency rate fell to 23 percent in 2025, from 38 percent in 2024 and 46 percent in 2023
Gives the scale: 143 firms inspected, portions of 780 audits reviewed
Notes Part I.A blends financial-statement and ICFR opinions, with no ITGC-only breakdown published
Draws the practical implication: continued auditor focus on evidence sufficiency in ICFR, including IT general controls
